meta.source: Built from the UNICEN wordmark (JPG). navy and orange are sampled from the logo; every other color is derived and marked so.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand primary, sampled from the wordmark letters. Logo ink, headings and primary buttons on light grounds. 15:1 on white.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand accent, sampled from the dot inside the C. Use as a fill (dots, badges, highlights, focus ring) — NOT for body text on white (3.2:1, passes only at 24px+ or for icons). Navy text on orange: 4.8:1.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Derived (white ground from the logo; dark is a deep navy).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised cards, table stripes, input fills. Derived.

tokens.name: navy-tint
tokens.usage: Soft navy wash for selected rows, tags and info panels. Navy text on it: 12.7:1. Derived.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Large brand fields (hero bands, the cover slab, footer). Navy in light; a lifted navy in dark so the field doesn't vanish into the ground. White text on it in both themes. Derived for dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text on surface-100/200. 15:1 light, 15.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, taglines. 6.2:1+ on surface-200 in both themes. Derived.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy / brand-surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Interactive primary: button fill, links. Dark theme uses a light navy so it reads on the dark ground (8:1). Derived for dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary-filled button. 15:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it must be TEXT (eyebrows, inline highlights). 5.2:1 on white, 7.4:1 on dark ground. Derived from orange.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines (not for control boundaries). Derived.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, 3:1+ on surface-100 in both themes. Derived.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline — the brand dot as a focus signal. 3.2:1 on white, 5.5:1 on dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Derived; not a brand color.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid borders. Derived; not a brand color.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, button labels in caps — echoes the all-caps wordmark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards — matches the soft terminals of the wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, hero blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars and the brand dot.
